review_note: DRAFT, owner must review. Not published: validation.py refuses this sheet until draft is false and the word DRAFT is gone from its text. Flanks come from search summaries of the reports, and the wedges are coarse and overlap, because channel lines are not chosen, so a detection may not be in the gully itself. Numbers use the PROVISIONAL brightness threshold and will change with the final value. The rule was changed once after seeing results: comparing with quiet pairs that also count coherence loss gave no for all three, but this pair has no coherence data, so that comparison was unfair.
method: DRAFT, owner must review. Each gully named in the source was checked as a 60-degree wedge of its flank from the summit, out to its reported lava flow length. This pair has no coherence data, so only brightness change was used, at the PROVISIONAL threshold. A gully counts as detected if flagged area is above all 5 quiet track 111 pairs in the same wedge, measured the same way. This shows change on the flank, not a confirmed deposit in the gully.
